overview: Grimling Forest is the battleground between Grimling tribes, Acrylia-tainted forces, and Seru expeditionary patrols. The outer forest is a warfront, while the interior is a corrupted horror biome.
history: Grimling tribes unified under war-chiefs after discovering Acrylia fragments.
Seru expeditionary forces established patrol routes to contain Grimling expansion.
Burrow Warrens formed when corrupted wildlife tunneled into Acrylia veins.
Forest Heartlands became unstable as corruption spread through deep-root systems.
Acrylia Approach emerged as a hotspot of tainted crystal growth.
regionHooks: A Grimling war-chief rallies tribes for a major offensive.
Acrylia corruption spreads into the Heartlands.
Seru patrols discover a new Acrylia vein beneath the Warrens.
Burrow creatures begin attacking Grimling encampments.
A corrupted forest spirit awakens in the deep woods.
